title: Technology Sector Update for 12/10/2018: XNET,MITK,LITB
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Tech Stocks
MSFT +2.33%
AAPL +0.79%
IBM +1.59%
CSCO +1.06%
GOOG +0.82%
Technology stocks were advancing in recent trading, with the shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 Monday gaining 1.3%, while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was rising 1.5%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(-) Xunlei ( XNET ) slipped after the digital media content company announced a strategic partnership with a China Mobile ( CHL ) subsidiary to jointly develop Internet of Things industry applications using blockchain technology.
In other sector news:
(+) Mitek Systems ( MITK ) was 9% higher after ASG Technologies increased its acquisition offer for the software firm to $11.50 per share from $10.
(-) LightInTheBox Holding Co ( LITB ) dropped 7.3%. It said it closed on its acquisition of Ezbuy Holding, a Singapore-based e-commerce platform.
